entities.title: High-score API
entities.summary: POST game, POST score and GET scores under /games/retro/hivestorm/api/.
guarantees: POST score takes { id, runs, names }, one name or null per player, and answers { entries: [{ player, name, score, wave, rank }] } with player counted from 1
GET scores answers { scores: [{ name, score, wave, players }] }, at most ten
Errors are JSON { error } with 400, 404, 409, 413, 422 or 500; the sign-in library's refusal is 401

entities.title: hivestorm-scores tables
entities.summary: games (issued seeds) and scores (replayed players' scores) in D1.
guarantees: A score row is keyed by its game (the seed's id) and the player (0 or 1), and records how many played
Scores are listed best first, ties oldest first (index scores_by_score)
Only the name is stored about a player
entities.compatibility: schema.sql describes a fresh database; the live one changes only through worker/migrations/, applied by hand before merging. Hivestorm has no migration yet.

entities.title: Public addresses
entities.summary: The game at /games/retro/hivestorm/ and its scores at /games/retro/hivestorm/scores/.
consumers: Players' bookmarks, and links from icelander.net and the multiplayer page (which adds ?match=ID)
guarantees: /games/retro/hivestorm/scores redirects to the page with a trailing slash
